hints.text: This clue's indicators are 'occupied by', and 'texting'. 'texting' is a kind of translation indicator where we have to translate some neighbouring fodder into text-speak. If you don't know much text-speak, feel free to look it up! And 'occupied by' is a containing indicator - some fodder will be occupied by and house other fodder.

This clue's fodder is 'but' and 'right now'. We'll need to find a specific kind of substitute for one of these and use it with the letters of the other to construct our answer, as guided by the clue's indicator(s).
Our definition here is 'Very well done', and our answer will be a word that can also mean 'very well done', in certain contexts.
